就在两人斗嘴的时候，王野，秦天熙和陈少峰三人悄悄的离开了客厅，来到了院子里。

王野掏出一盒烟分别递给两人一根儿，秦天熙接过烟问道：“小野，晚上有时间吗，今儿我们哥们儿去老莫，一起呀？”

王野知道这是秦天熙在给他拓展人脉，秦伟和秦天熙看重的是这帮二代的父辈儿关系，而王野看中的就是他们这帮人。这些人只要是在未来十几二十年内不作死，个顶个都是社会的精英人士。

王野点点头：“行啊，我也见识见识传说中的老莫，就我这种土包子还真没去过。”

陈少峰瞥了一眼王野：“行了，你小子会看的上这个，在老莫吃一顿，一人也就是十块八块的，你小子做的那些菜，那个是花钱能吃到的。

上次吃完我就留意了一下，就那个鲍鱼，我还真找到了，比你这个小一半，踏马要我15块钱。”

秦天熙以为自己听错了问道：“你说多少？”

陈少峰：“15一个，踏马的，15块钱买一口肉。我当时也是脑子抽了，买了两个，回去自己做了。那叫一个难吃，不仅腥，而且还咬不动，就跟吃皮带一样。”

王野：“峰哥，你挺厉害呀，自己做鲍鱼，这东西不正经学也就是你这种不差钱儿的敢这么嚯嚯。”

陈少峰：“谁跟你说我不差钱了？”

王野：“东直门外的鸽子市，是你们的吧？”

陈少峰转头看了一眼秦天熙，秦天熙微微点头，陈少峰才回答道：“是啊，但是参与的人多了，能分多少呀。”

“人多，是多少呀？”

秦天熙接过话：“二十多个。”

王野琢磨了一下：“那是不多，我看规模你们每个月也就分百八十的吧？”

陈少峰转头又看向秦天熙，秦天熙赶紧解释道：“我可没说啊！”

王野继续说道：“就这么点事儿，还用我大哥跟我说呀，那鸽子市我去过，单凭收点进门费，你们每个月估计连二十块钱都够呛，估计那个管事儿的，应该也倒卖些稀罕物吧？”

组织鸽子市理论上是可以的，但是鸽子市的组织者少有不参与倒买倒卖的。听到王野说倒卖的问题陈少峰和秦天熙都提高了警惕。

王野看着两人的神情：“放轻松，现在来说不是什么大事儿，退一步说你俩又没直接参与，问题不大。”

秦天熙：“小野，这事儿可大可小，可不能跟外人说。”

王野点点头：“放心吧大哥，我是那不知道轻重的人吗。”

聊了几句陈少峰就告辞离开了，王野又递给秦天熙一根儿烟：“大哥，鸽子市你参与的有多深，舅舅知不知道？”

While the two were bickering, Wang Ye, Qin Tianxi and Chen Shaofeng quietly left the living room and came to the yard.

Wang Ye took out a box of cigarettes and handed each of them one cigarette. Qin Tianxi took the cigarette and asked, "Xiao Ye, do you have time in the evening? Let's go to Lao Mo today, shall we go together?"

Wang Ye knew that Qin Tianxi was trying to expand his network of contacts. Qin Wei and Qin Tianxi valued the relationship between fathers and sons of the second generation, while Wang Ye valued these people.As long as these people do not commit suicide in the next ten or twenty years, they will all be elites in society.

Wang Ye nodded: "Okay, I've also met the legendary Lao Mo, but a bumpkin like me has never been there."

Chen Shaofeng glanced at Wang Ye: "Okay, your kid will like this. A meal at Lao Mo is only ten or eight yuan per person. Those dishes your kid cooked can be eaten with money."

I paid attention after eating last time, and I actually found that abalone. It was half the size of yours. It cost me 15 yuan to step on the horse."

Qin Tianxi thought he heard wrongly and asked, "How much did you say?"

Chen Shaofeng: "15 each, horse riding, 15 yuan to buy a mouthful of meat. I was crazy at the time, so I bought two and made them myself when I went back. It was unpalatable. Not only was it fishy, but it was also hard to bite, just like eating a leather belt."

Wang Ye: "Brother Feng, you are very good at making abalone yourself. This is not a serious thing to learn, and only someone like you who is not short of money dares to do it like this."

Chen Shaofeng: "Who told you that I am not short of money?"

Wang Ye: "The pigeon market outside Dongzhimen belongs to you, right?"

Chen Shaofeng turned his head and glanced at Qin Tianxi. Qin Tianxi nodded slightly, and then Chen Shaofeng replied: "Yes, but there are more people involved, how much can be divided."

"There are many people, how many are they?"

Qin Tianxi took over: "More than twenty."

Wang Ye thought about it for a while: "That's not much. I think you only get 80 percent of it every month, right?"

Chen Shaofeng turned to look at Qin Tianxi again. Qin Tianxi quickly explained: "I didn't say anything!"

Wang Ye continued: "It's just such a small thing, why don't you tell me, my elder brother, I've been to the pigeon market, and just for the entry fee, you probably can't even make twenty yuan a month. I guess the person in charge should be reselling some rare items, right?"

It is theoretically possible to organize a pigeon market, but there are few organizers of pigeon markets who do not engage in buying and selling.After hearing Wang Ye talk about reselling, Chen Shaofeng and Qin Tianxi both became more vigilant.

Wang Ye looked at the expressions of the two of them: "Relax, it's not a big deal now. If you take a step back and say that you two are not directly involved, it's not a big problem."

Qin Tianxi: "Xiaoye, this matter is big or small, but you can't tell outsiders."

Wang Ye nodded: "Don't worry, brother, am I the one who doesn't know the importance?"

After chatting for a while, Chen Shaofeng said goodbye and left. Wang Ye handed Qin Tianxi another cigarette: "Brother, does your uncle know how deeply you are involved in the Pigeon Market?"
